source_supported: SNL37:039 lists two M641 triangular fulcrum brackets, each with one 1/4 x 1-3/4 inch split pin; no separate fulcrum pin is listed in that assembly.
SNL116:020 lists ten M640 rocking levers: eight center-rod applications and one on each M641. This increment models only the two M641 applications.

SNL172:002 lists six 11/16 x 1-1/2 inch button-head rivets for plate M1936 and bracket printed M6412; the final 2 is present in the scan. Association with M641 is selected provisionally, not silently corrected.
M578 rear foot-brake rods terminate between the retained horizontal fulcrum and a center foot-brake rocker, with M569C fork ends.
M568C (39.6875 mm selected under-head length) is reused with the M569C forks; M568A is not substituted.
approximations: M641 reconstructed as a triangular foot, outboard upright and integral cantilever journal, retained by the assembly-listed split pin. This avoids an unlisted separate pivot pin and preserves clearance for the complete lower clevis/pin envelope. Cast form and journal dimensions are inferred.

M640 common journal changed from Gemini 13 mm assumption to estimated 25.65 mm bore on a 25.4 mm shaft, consistent qualitatively with the smaller intermediate shaft versus the source-dimensioned 38.0238 mm driver shaft. Exact intermediate shaft/journal diameter is not printed; source silhouette remains a check, not a dimensional claim.
M640 88.9 mm arm radius, 34 mm hub width, 44.45 mm boss outside diameter and 12 mm eye width remain estimates. Both upper and lower 13 mm pin bores are cut after all stock unions.

Floor-6 support stations X3350 and Y +/-521.3976048 mm retain the provisional center station and align the rear connections with existing actual rod eyes. Rigid bracket hand is selected so the upright lies outboard on both sides.
M578 solid 19.05 mm rod core, smooth nominal threads and fork insertion are estimates; printed source family/count is retained.
Rivet stock length is treated as under-head length. Spherical factory/upset head envelopes are estimates; the upset conserves remaining shank stock.
requirements: Real floor-6 receiver holes, all existing plate features preserved.
Full rivet grip and bearing faces; no floor mating exemptions.
Journal engagement, rocker bore continuity and retention; complete fork/pin/cotter clearance against upright.
Actual rod socket engagement, correct M568C pin, receiver axes and thread/nut coverage.
Independent full retained-material context, nominal/variation, strict native/STEP, additive/revised-definition preservation.
